panels.description: Load (query time per second, the same as QAN Load) of the 10 queries with the most execution time in the selected range. Shows whether a top query is a steady load or a spike.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    toStartOfInterval(period_start, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) second) AS time,
    concat(database, '.', arrayStringConcat(tables, ','), ' - ', substring(fingerprint, 1, 45)) AS query,
    sum(m_query_time_sum) / greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS "Load"
FROM pmm."metrics"
WHERE
    period_start >= $__fromTime
    AND period_start <= $__toTime
    AND service_type = 'mongodb'
    AND match(environment, '^${environment:regex}$')
    AND match(cluster, '^${cluster:regex}$')
    AND match(node_name, '^${node_name:regex}$')
    AND match(service_name, '^${service_name:regex}$')
    AND match(replication_set, '^${replication_set:regex}$')
    AND match(node_type, '^${node_type:regex}$')
    AND match(toString(agent_type), '^${agent_type:regex}$')
    AND fingerprint != ''
    AND queryid IN (
        SELECT queryid
        FROM pmm."metrics"
        WHERE
    period_start >= $__fromTime
    AND period_start <= $__toTime
    AND service_type = 'mongodb'
    AND match(environment, '^${environment:regex}$')
    AND match(cluster, '^${cluster:regex}$')
    AND match(node_name, '^${node_name:regex}$')
    AND match(service_name, '^${service_name:regex}$')
    AND match(replication_set, '^${replication_set:regex}$')
    AND match(node_type, '^${node_type:regex}$')
    AND match(toString(agent_type), '^${agent_type:regex}$')
            AND fingerprint != ''
        GROUP BY queryid
        ORDER BY sum(m_query_time_sum) DESC
        LIMIT 10
    )
GROUP BY time, query
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Top 10 Queries by Time Spent — Trend

panels.description: MongoDB queries with the slowest average execution time. The average is execution-weighted (total time / total count); check Executed before acting on a row.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    cluster AS "Cluster",
    service_name AS "Service Name",
    queryid AS "Query ID",
    database AS "Database",
    arrayStringConcat(tables, ', ') AS "Collection",
    fingerprint AS "Query",
    sum(m_query_time_sum) / nullIf(sum(m_query_time_cnt), 0) AS "Avg Execution Time",
    sum(num_queries) AS "Executed"
FROM pmm."metrics"
WHERE
    period_start >= $__fromTime
    AND period_start <= $__toTime
    AND service_type = 'mongodb'
    AND match(environment, '^${environment:regex}$')
    AND match(cluster, '^${cluster:regex}$')
    AND match(node_name, '^${node_name:regex}$')
    AND match(service_name, '^${service_name:regex}$')
    AND match(replication_set, '^${replication_set:regex}$')
    AND match(node_type, '^${node_type:regex}$')
    AND match(toString(agent_type), '^${agent_type:regex}$')
    AND fingerprint != ''
GROUP BY
    cluster,
    service_name,
    queryid,
    database,
    tables,
    fingerprint
HAVING sum(m_query_time_cnt) > 0
ORDER BY "Avg Execution Time" DESC
LIMIT 10;

panels.title: Top 10 Queries Returning the Most Documents

panels.description: MongoDB queries which examined the most documents. Examined / Returned is the query targeting ratio; where nothing was returned it falls back to the raw examined count.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    cluster AS "Cluster",
    service_name AS "Service Name",
    queryid AS "Query ID",
    database AS "Database",
    arrayStringConcat(tables, ', ') AS "Collection",
    fingerprint AS "Query",
    sum(m_docs_examined_sum) AS "Docs Examined",
    sum(m_keys_examined_sum) AS "Keys Examined",
    sum(m_docs_examined_sum) / greatest(sum(m_docs_returned_sum), 1) AS "Examined / Returned"
FROM pmm."metrics"
WHERE
    period_start >= $__fromTime
    AND period_start <= $__toTime
    AND service_type = 'mongodb'
    AND match(environment, '^${environment:regex}$')
    AND match(cluster, '^${cluster:regex}$')
    AND match(node_name, '^${node_name:regex}$')
    AND match(service_name, '^${service_name:regex}$')
    AND match(replication_set, '^${replication_set:regex}$')
    AND match(node_type, '^${node_type:regex}$')
    AND match(toString(agent_type), '^${agent_type:regex}$')
    AND fingerprint != ''
GROUP BY
    cluster,
    service_name,
    queryid,
    database,
    tables,
    fingerprint
ORDER BY "Docs Examined" DESC
LIMIT 10;

panels.title: Top 10 Queries Examining the Most Documents

panels.description: Documents examined per document returned — MongoDB's query targeting ratio. 1 is ideal; large values mean the query reads far more than it needs. Keys Examined / Returned near 0 alongside a high ratio means no index was used. Operations that return no documents (writes, zero-match reads) are excluded because the ratio is undefined for them — see the Docs Examined and Collection Scans panels for those.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    cluster AS "Cluster",
    service_name AS "Service Name",
    queryid AS "Query ID",
    database AS "Database",
    arrayStringConcat(tables, ', ') AS "Collection",
    fingerprint AS "Query",
    sum(m_docs_examined_sum) / sum(m_docs_returned_sum) AS "Docs Examined / Returned",
    sum(m_keys_examined_sum) / sum(m_docs_returned_sum) AS "Keys Examined / Returned",
    sum(m_docs_examined_sum) AS "Docs Examined",
    sum(m_docs_returned_sum) AS "Docs Returned",
    sum(num_queries) AS "Executed"
FROM pmm."metrics"
WHERE
    period_start >= $__fromTime
    AND period_start <= $__toTime
    AND service_type = 'mongodb'
    AND match(environment, '^${environment:regex}$')
    AND match(cluster, '^${cluster:regex}$')
    AND match(node_name, '^${node_name:regex}$')
    AND match(service_name, '^${service_name:regex}$')
    AND match(replication_set, '^${replication_set:regex}$')
    AND match(node_type, '^${node_type:regex}$')
    AND match(toString(agent_type), '^${agent_type:regex}$')
    AND fingerprint != ''
GROUP BY
    cluster,
    service_name,
    queryid,
    database,
    tables,
    fingerprint
HAVING sum(m_docs_returned_sum) > 0 AND sum(m_docs_examined_sum) > 0
ORDER BY "Docs Examined / Returned" DESC
LIMIT 10;

panels.title: Top 10 Queries by Poor Query Targeting

panels.description: Queries whose plan was a full COLLSCAN — no index was used — ranked by total execution time. These are the strongest candidates for a new index. Note the plan is recorded per execution, so a query appears here only for the periods it actually scanned.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    cluster AS "Cluster",
    service_name AS "Service Name",
    queryid AS "Query ID",
    database AS "Database",
    arrayStringConcat(tables, ', ') AS "Collection",
    fingerprint AS "Query",
    sum(m_query_time_sum) AS "Execution Time",
    sum(num_queries) AS "Executed",
    sum(m_docs_examined_sum) AS "Docs Examined",
    sum(m_docs_examined_sum) / greatest(sum(m_docs_returned_sum), 1) AS "Examined / Returned"
FROM pmm."metrics"
WHERE
    period_start >= $__fromTime
    AND period_start <= $__toTime
    AND service_type = 'mongodb'
    AND match(environment, '^${environment:regex}$')
    AND match(cluster, '^${cluster:regex}$')
    AND match(node_name, '^${node_name:regex}$')
    AND match(service_name, '^${service_name:regex}$')
    AND match(replication_set, '^${replication_set:regex}$')
    AND match(node_type, '^${node_type:regex}$')
    AND match(toString(agent_type), '^${agent_type:regex}$')
    AND fingerprint != ''
    AND plan_summary = 'COLLSCAN'
GROUP BY
    cluster,
    service_name,
    queryid,
    database,
    tables,
    fingerprint
ORDER BY "Execution Time" DESC
LIMIT 10;

panels.description: MongoDB users who executed the most queries, aggregated per user (not per database). Services shows how many monitored services the user was seen on.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    cluster AS "Cluster",
    username AS "Username",
    sum(num_queries) AS "Executed Queries",
    countDistinct(service_name) AS "Services",
    countDistinct(database) AS "Databases",
    sum(m_query_time_sum) AS "Total Time"
FROM pmm."metrics"
WHERE
    period_start >= $__fromTime
    AND period_start <= $__toTime
    AND service_type = 'mongodb'
    AND match(environment, '^${environment:regex}$')
    AND match(cluster, '^${cluster:regex}$')
    AND match(node_name, '^${node_name:regex}$')
    AND match(service_name, '^${service_name:regex}$')
    AND match(replication_set, '^${replication_set:regex}$')
    AND match(node_type, '^${node_type:regex}$')
    AND match(toString(agent_type), '^${agent_type:regex}$')
GROUP BY
    cluster,
    username
ORDER BY "Executed Queries" DESC
LIMIT 10;
